purpose: Prepare the actual Reader Edition join so verified research can be inserted as separate support the moment returns arrive.

state_transform_done.state: Reader-aid admissions exist or will arrive independently from research.
state_transform_done.transform: Join only READY_FOR_ASSEMBLY aids to their stable paragraph anchors while preserving source paragraphs byte-for-byte.

invariants: Reader aids remain a separate subordinate layer.
Held, recast, and no-insert returns never leak into reader-facing support.
The same function works with zero, some, or all verified aids.
